page_title: NAN 3-3 MON | Nantes v Monaco 25/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Florent Mollet (Nantes) but poses no threat.
90+4' The resulting corner, taken by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco), comes to nothing.

90+4' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Remy Descamps! Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
90+3' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but Remy Descamps punches the ball away.
90+1' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Nantes for a penalty. Play continues.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:24.

85' 3 - 3 Youssouf Fofana unleashes a shot but the ball bounces back off the post. Myron Boadu (Monaco) is first to latch onto the rebound and his close-range header goes inside the right post. He makes it 3:3.
85' Substitution. Soungoutou Magassa walks off the pitch and Myron Boadu (Monaco) comes on as a substitute.
83' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
83' Monaco take a short corner kick.
83' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
81' Pierre Aristouy decides to make a substitution. Mostafa Mohamed will be replaced by Florent Mollet (Nantes).
81' Substitution. Quentin Merlin makes way for Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes).
80' What a long-range shot by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
80' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

79' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
79' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
78' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
78' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
78' Caio Henrique (Monaco) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Monaco force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

77' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
75' CHANCE! Caio Henrique (Monaco) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Remy Descamps, who reacts superbly to stop him.
74' Substitution. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Vanderson walks off.
74' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Remy Descamps.
74' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
73' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
71' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Remy Descamps is alert and denies him.
69' Pierre Aristouy has decided to make a change. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) replaces Moses Simon.
69' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) comes onto the pitch because Douglas Augusto simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
68' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
67' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
66' Moses Simon (Nantes) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Mostafa Mohamed wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
66' Monaco couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Remy Descamps (Nantes) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
65' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
63' A cooling break is underway.
61' Substitution. Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) has come on for Kader Bamba.
58' 3 - 2 The attempt by Mohamed Camara is blocked, but from the middle of the box Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) hits the rebound into the bottom right corner. He alters the score to 3:2.
58' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
57' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Remy Descamps intercepts the ball.
56' Good clearance! Mohamed Camara (Monaco) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
54' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Vanderson (Monaco) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
54' Jeremie Pignard shows the yellow card to Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) for a heavy challenge.
51' Monaco fail to score from a corner as Remy Descamps (Nantes) leaps to collect the ball.
51' Vanderson (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
50' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' 3 - 1 Goal! Quentin Merlin shows great vision to find Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
47' Vanderson (Monaco) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jeremie Pignard blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Vanderson (Monaco) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
42' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is caught offside!
40' Kader Bamba (Nantes) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
38' Caio Henrique (Monaco) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
36' Moses Simon (Nantes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

35' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Remy Descamps shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

33' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
31' Kader Bamba (Nantes) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
28' Moses Simon (Nantes) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

27' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Caio Henrique and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Remy Descamps was helpless.
24' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
23' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

23' Vanderson (Monaco) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
20' Moses Simon (Nantes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
19' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Vanderson (Monaco), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
19' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

15' 2 - 0 Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:0.
15' Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' PENALTY APPEAL by Monaco, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
13' Caio Henrique (Monaco) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
12' Half-chance! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) plays a pass into the box, but Remy Descamps reacts well to snuff out the attack.
10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
10' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
10' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Stephane Singo (Monaco), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
8' Caio Henrique (Monaco) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
7' Today's referee Jeremie Pignard rightly decides to book Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) for his harsh tackle.
5' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Philipp Kohn no chance!
5' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
4' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Nantes!

2' Moses Simon (Nantes) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
1' Stephane Singo (Monaco) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Nantes will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jeremie Pignard.
